info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Petadoption Pets Schedule Visit-v1-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Visit Scheduling API allows users to efficiently schedule visits for adopting pets. This endpoint facilitates the creation of appointments where prospective pet adopters can meet and interact with available pets. It serves animal shelters, pet adoption agencies, and anyone aiming to streamline the pet adoption process. By simplifying visit scheduling, this API enhances user engagement and increases the chances of successful adoptions.

post.summary: Schedule a visit for a pet.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to schedule a visit for a pet, enabling effective management of appointments and ensuring the pet receives timely care.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to schedule a visit for a pet. It contains the necessary information required to perform the scheduling operation including details about the pet and the requested appointment time.
